repoStandards.note: Failed only on documented unrelated oversized-file baseline debt listed in mission AGENTS.md.

blockingIssues.description: The callback typing sweep is incomplete: `(def.models || []).map((m) => ({ ... }))` still leaves `m` implicitly typed in a feature-targeted file, so VAL-TYPE-006 is not fully satisfied.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document an explicit scoped-validation fallback for `npm run check:repo-standards` (and related global guardrails) when mission guidance already documents unrelated baseline failures outside the worker diff.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: This was reported across multiple type-safety reviews (fix-record-string-any, add-explicit-return-types + finish-agent-loop-return-types, fix-catch-any-patterns, fix-unsafe-casts, fix-callback-types, add-oauth-guard-regression-tests).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance for verification-only sessions where the assigned feature is already landed on the branch, so workers can switch to audit/validation mode without marking normal process deviations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The fix-callback-types review recorded this gap after the worker found the commit already present and correctly audited the landed state instead of re-implementing it.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that small async test-harness updates are acceptable when they are required to add regression coverage for promise-based flows.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The add-oauth-guard-regression-tests review found the feature needed a minimal async runner improvement before it could assert rejected OAuth flow promises directly.

rejectedObservations.observation: Multiple differently worded reports about repo-standards fallback pressure in refactor-worker.

nonBlockingIssues.description: tests/e2e/test-model-communication.ts references outer-scope `getErrorMessage` from inside `worker.evaluate(...)`, so that catch path would raise `ReferenceError` if exercised.
